user.title: Moma
user.description: Moma devices announce themselves by UDP broadcast, so there is nothing to look up: no IP address and no name. Devices appear within one broadcast interval.

data_description.port: The UDP port the devices broadcast to. Leave this at 8484 unless you know it was changed.

abort.already_configured: Another Moma entry is already listening on this port.

all_fields_zero.title: Moma device reports only zeroes
all_fields_zero.description:
Packets from {devices} are arriving on port {port}, so the connection is fine. But every field reads zero, and a field only becomes a sensor once it has reported a value other than zero. That is why this integration currently has no entities and no device at all.

This is normal for hardware that is installed but not yet in use. It resolves by itself as soon as the device starts measuring.

To see the fields right away anyway, turn on **Show all fields** under the integration options. Sensors created that way do not disappear when you switch it off again.

data_description.show_all_fields: Normally a field only becomes a sensor once it reports a value other than zero, so unused hardware does not clutter your system. Switch this on to create sensors for every field immediately - useful while testing against an idle device.
